compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values using the mae metric function
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values using the mse metric function
compute_cosine_similarity: compute the cosine similarity between predicted and target tensor embeddings using the cosine_similarity metric function
compute_per_atom_mae: compute the per-atom mean absolute error by dividing prediction errors by the number of atoms in the target
compute_energy_forces_within_threshold: compute the fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03
